desc: Radical Firearms is a home grown Texas based firearms manufacturer that takes pride in producing some of the best AR platform rifles on the market today. The Radical Firearms RF10 RBR10-65C-24 is an optics ready AR style rifle chambered in the amazing 6.5mm Creedmoor cartridge. This is a fantastic AR with precision machined Radical RF-10 7075-T6 billet aluminum receivers and a DPMS pattern high-profile upper. It starts with a medium contour 24" 416R stainless steel barrel that's threaded 5/8x24 with a Radical Firearms MS compensator. Featuring a free float Radical Firearms 15" TMS low profile handguard that has a full length picatinny top rail, it readily accepts Magpul M-LOK attachments. It comes with a Mission First Tactical Minimalist Stock to help reduce weight without sacrificing fit or performance. Perfect for hunting, home defense or competition, this is the ideal ultra-long range AR that you've been looking for.
